authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10930.1 *latta gives Awan lattā “clothes”, Kumauni lattā and Hindi lattā “tattered cloth”. Rana latta fits the expressive defective/rag family; this does not assert an independently settled Sanskrit origin. Joint comparison: MagahiNepal lattā “cloth” matches reviewed Rana lʌtːa “cloth” (f_pkc5zm2mdc6cc). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13161 saptāha means a period of seven days and gives Nepali sātā “week”. Rajasthani sapta/sapto preserve learned pt with regional final adaptation; this family link leaves learned or neighboring Indo-Aryan transmission open. Joint comparison: MagahiNepal saptā “week” matches reviewed had saptā “week” (f_rf3isi4lccmes). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
